title: occupancy-heat-hint-mapper-and-spillback-regulator
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We observed repeated small spill windows during mixed-query workloads where fragmentation and tenant-interference caused frequent micro-spills that increased tail latency and I/O churn. This PR introduces an occupancy heatmap hinting layer plus a spillback regulator that cooperates with the KV cache evictor and the request scheduler to reduce unnecessary paging and make evictions more spatially aware. Changes include a lightweight sampler that maintains per-segment occupancy estimates, a hint map exported to the evictor to prefer co-located eviction candidates, and a spillback regulator that tracks in-flight spill amplification and throttles low-priority drains to bound I/O pressure. The design emphasizes low-cost sampling, local decision heuristics, and compatibility with the existing eviction pipeline to avoid large refactors. Summary of changes: 1) new module runtime/kv/occupancy_hint_map.go implementing an atomic, residency-weighted occupancy heatmap and public API for hint queries; 2) eviction/evictor: integration points for hint queries and a small scoring bump for contiguous slots to prefer coalesced evictions; 3) pager/spillback: regulator that monitors bytes/sec and ongoing spill tasks and applies backpressure on spill triggers coming from eviction; 4) scheduler: minor change to batching scheduler to respect spillback signals and prefer cache-friendly requests when regulator is active; 5) telemetry: metrics and histogram buckets for occupancy snapshots, spill throttle events, and hint-to-evictor match rate; 6) tests: unit and integrated perf harness that reproduces mixed small-read large-write workload used during profiling, and a new e2e scenario in perf-canary. Notable behavior: under mixed workloads this yields 10-18% fewer spill operations, lowers disk write bursts by ~22% in our canary, and reduces end-to-end 99th percentile latency by ~6-10% on heavy-tenant scenarios. Backward compatibility: the hint map is optional and off-by-default behind feature flag kv.occupancy_hint.enabled; the spillback regulator has conservative safe defaults and will not prevent required writes. Rollout plan: ship as feature-flag behind canary, monitor hint_match_rate and spill_throttle_count; if safe, enable by tenant cohorts then globally. Checklist: automated unit tests added, integration tests in perf-canary added, added telemetry dashboards for the new metrics, feature flag gated, documented implementation and tuning knobs in internal docs. Related tasks: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2201, ENG-2278. CI: requires full integration test due to scheduler interaction. Merge: squash+merge after signoff.

release_notes: Introduces an opt-in occupancy heatmap and spillback regulator to reduce micro-spills and improve tail latency under mixed workloads. Feature is behind kv.occupancy_hint and disabled by default.
reviews: Marco Chen: The occupancy map looks good; one question about atomic snapshot cost under very high churn. Please add a microbenchmark for the sampler's overhead.

Aisha Patel: Added sampler microbench in runtime/kv/occupancy_hint_test.go with a 95th percentile allocation of 0 bytes and <0.2% CPU impact in our harness. Also clarified the map eviction hook to be non-blocking.
Priya Rao: Approved after nit on metrics naming; please use 'kv.occupancy_snapshot_ms' for histogram buckets instead of 'kv.occupancy_ms'.
Luca Bianchi: Left one suggestion about lowering default throttle aggression; updated defaults per comment and re-ran canary, saw reduction in regression risk.
Marco Chen: Approving final changes. CI green, integration perf flakiness resolved by increasing timeout on e2e scenario.
notes: Testing notes: perf-canary showed 22% reduction in write burst in staging region-3 during a 6-hour mixed-run; we observed a 14% reduction in total spill bytes and a 9% improvement in eviction locality. Observability: new Grafana dashboard 'KV Occupancy Heat' was added to the internal dashboards folder and alerts created for high hint_miss_rate and sustained spill_throttle_count > 20/min. Tuning knobs: occupancy_sample_rate (default 0.01), spill_throttle_threshold_bytes_per_sec (default 50MB/s), contiguous_eviction_bonus (default 0.15).
migration_instructions: Enable feature flag kv.occupancy_hint.enabled in a single canary cluster, monitor kv.hint_match_rate and kv.spill_throttle_count for 48 hours, then gradually increase to 25% tenants before full roll. If hint_match_rate < 0.6 or spill_throttle_count spikes, roll back flag and collect sampler traces for investigation.
